“哼，那肯定不是我认识的那个绝情的五行仙尊。”五姑娘对于她父亲似乎有一股很深的仇恨。

想到她和哥哥最近的状态，或许是回到之前的家里住了，慕容凌便开车赶到苏樱之前和苏秉怀住的地方。

“我不答应！”冲口而出，才察觉自己太过冲动，她不该将与南门尊的私人恩怨放在工作上，那些私底下的憎恨厌恶也不该带来。

倒了一瓶子一蜂蜜，想来这话，只有段誉这种人，才想得出来吧？

其实方才一路行来，众人已见到不少花灯了，但都是行人或路边的住户零散挂出来的，一进灯市，却又截然不同，真真是火树银花、缤纷璀璨，众人只觉得满眼都是光，红的黄的绿的蓝的，又有无数的花样，让人目不暇接。

想起那一日在民政局门口，他早早的等待着，却看到她和欧阳洛甜蜜的就好似多年的恋人，那么迫不及待的想要和自己离婚。

在尖叫声中，她静静望着他，垂目落在两人紧紧牵住的手上，她张嘴，“我们结婚了，是真的一生不弃吗？”说完，她便笑了，凌乱中他可能连她的口型都看不分明。

聂采月一看到段青茗开心的样子，立时黯了眼神。这段青茗，虽然再三表示对刘渊无意，可是，看到刘渊来，还如此开心，难道说，她意识到了什么么？

车子行驶在西环车辆稀少的地方，窜出一辆大货车撞向那辆黑色轿车。紧随其后的另一辆轿车怕攻前面黑色轿车的车位急切的打方向。打方向过猛与迎面驶来的保时捷车相撞。

两个世间最优秀的男子，就在这个寻常的时光，望着对方的眼神，犹如利剑出鞘。

“陈思南，没想到你居然也破圣了。”机械化的玄奘看着陈思南感叹道。

杨森刚才也看到了那人被活活的烧成骷髅架子，又怎么会又丝毫的大意。

风魔犬的眼睛里面已经开始扫射出来一股杀意，动荡无比，让在场感受到了这一股杀意的人都是一阵下意识的惊恐和畏惧。

"Huh, that's definitely not the ruthless Five Elements Immortal I know." The fifth girl seemed to have a deep hatred for her father.

Thinking of her and her brother's recent state, perhaps returning to their previous home, Murong Ling drove to the place where Su Ying and Su Binghuai lived.

"I don't agree!" she blurted out, then realized that she was too impulsive. She should not put her personal grudges with Nanmen Zun at work, nor should she bring about those private hatreds and disgusts.

I poured a bottle of honey. Only a person like Duan Yu could think of this, right?

In fact, everyone has seen many lanterns along the way, but they were all hung up by pedestrians or residents on the roadside. Once they entered the lantern market, they were completely different. They were really colorful and bright. Everyone felt that their eyes were full of lights, red, yellow, green, and blue, and there were countless patterns, which made people dizzy.

Thinking of that day at the door of the Civil Affairs Bureau, he had been waiting early, but he saw that she and Ouyang Luo were as sweet as lovers for many years, and they couldn't wait to divorce him.

Amid the screams, she looked at him quietly, lowering her eyes to the hands they were holding tightly. She opened her mouth, "We are married, are we really going to stay together for the rest of our lives?" After saying that, she smiled, and in the mess, he might not even be able to discern the shape of her mouth.

As soon as Nie Caiyue saw Duan Qingming's happy look, she immediately darkened her eyes.Although Qingming repeatedly expressed that she had no interest in Liu Yuan, she was still so happy when she saw Liu Yuan coming. Could it be that she realized something?

The car was driving in a sparsely trafficked area in Western District when a large truck sprang out and crashed into the black car.Another car following closely behind was afraid of entering the parking space of the black car in front and turned eagerly.He turned too sharply and collided with an oncoming Porsche.

Two of the best men in the world, at this ordinary time, looked at each other like swords unsheathed.

"Chen Sinan, I didn't expect you to break the Saint too." The mechanized Xuanzang looked at Chen Sinan and sighed.

Yang Sen had just seen that man being burned alive into a skeleton, so how could he be careless at all?

The Wind Demon Dog's eyes had begun to shoot out a murderous intent, which was so turbulent that everyone present who felt the murderous intent felt a subconscious panic and fear.
